bound_classes.name: locally_unique_reconstruction
bound_classes.condition: Within open admissibility window (epsilon > 0) with unique orientation and single-branch history.
bound_classes.description: Xi recovers a unique formal state preimage.

bound_classes.name: bounded_multi_preimage_reconstruction
bound_classes.condition: Finite multi-branch history with stable orientation-sensitive tie-breaking.
bound_classes.description: Xi recovers a finite, bounded set of admissible preimages.

bound_classes.name: partial_trace_reconstruction
bound_classes.condition: Partial information loss from Pi_A clipping or low-dimensional observable mapping.
bound_classes.description: Xi recovers state components preserved by the projection/mapping only.

bound_classes.name: globally_blocked_reconstruction
bound_classes.condition: Intrinsic many-to-one aggregation in NavT or irreducible branching in delta.
bound_classes.description: Global causal history recovery is formally impossible.
